AFRO 106.finalExam: Exams use multiple-choice and/or short-answer questions; the final's date is not given.

AFRO 106.attendance: Regular attendance and active participation are called of central importance; no penalty or percentage is stated.
AFRO 106.lateWork: Loses 10% of the possible credit after the class in which it is due, and 10% more for each later day.
AFRO 106.makeups: No make-ups for missed exams or assignments without a documented, legitimate medical or family emergency.
other: Course counts toward general education in Cultural Studies (Non-Western / U.S. Minority Culture) and Humanities & the Arts (Historical and Philosophical Perspec
